'''Project Second Chance''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] operation that employed [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to covertly transport a [[modular command circuit]] to the government of the [[Kalinda system/Legends|Kalinda system]] to allow them to activate their [[Kalindan Defense System|defense network]].
